name: Himitsu Inkou Chika Club ~Biyaku ni Oboreru Shitai~
original_name: 秘蜜淫交地下クラブ ～媚薬に溺れる肢体～
source:
Secret club gatherings involve the use of aphrodisiac lotion for group play and orgies! What will happen to the protagonist, who gets caught up in this underground world to protect his precious sister...?

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/1472]the official website[/url]]
